And the shot they showed as the winner was not against a 16 and 13 year old. How old am I that I remember him with long hair Really impressive would be ping pong but he doesn't want to get wiped by a mid pro . Did I hear that right? He beat a thirteen year old?! And that's not the focal point of the story? I'm so old I remember when he was mostly famous for taking Big $$$ for exhibition tennis tournaments then losing to a nobody in the 1st Round so he could leave .
